findings.message: LoadProfile now discards the error from FindByEmail and immediately dereferences u (u.Name). If FindByEmail returns an error (e.g. user not found or DB failure) with a nil *User, this panics instead of returning a wrapped error; callers also lose the ability to distinguish lookup failures.
findings.suggestion: Restore error handling: u, err := s.FindByEmail(email); if err != nil { return Profile{}, fmt.Errorf("load profile for %q: %w", email, err) } and only then build the Profile (or explicitly handle a not-found case with a defined fallback).
